verdict.rationale: Aider auto-stages and commits every AI edit with a descriptive commit message (docs-4), and the `/git` command exposes raw git commands for more complex history management like branching (docs-5), but there is no documented first-class feature for creating branches or opening pull requests — that would require manual git commands. Community feedback also flags commit-message quality as inconsistent (aider-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit branch-creation workflow, native PR-opening integration (e.g., GitHub CLI/API), and evidence these are supported beyond generic git passthrough.
